signal: Raised $24M. Already operates in Utah, Colorado, New York, and Texas, and the round funds expansion into New England, New Jersey, and the upper Midwest.
why_icp: Drill crews in a handful of states, about to add more. Every new state means new payroll tax registrations, which is exactly what Warp automates.
suggested_contact_title: CEO (Joselyn Lai) or Head of People / Finance
first_line: Congrats on the $24M. Expanding into New England and New Jersey means a lot of new state tax accounts to open.

signal: Raised a $34M Series A. Has 40 employees in the U.S. and plans to grow its U.S. presence.
why_icp: A company building a U.S. team on top of a non-U.S. setup. Running U.S. payroll, benefits, and global contractors in one place is the Warp pitch.
first_line: Congrats on the Series A. Growing past 40 people in the U.S. is usually when payroll and benefits get messy.

signal: Raised a $20M seed (Adjacent, Coinbase Ventures, USV) and plans to hire across engineering, design, and growth marketing.
why_icp: Seed-stage team that just announced a hiring push. The best moment to set up payroll and HR right instead of switching later.
first_line: Congrats on the $20M seed. Saw you are hiring across engineering, design, and growth.

signal: Raised a $7M seed led by Cowboy Ventures. 7 open roles across San Francisco, San Mateo, and New York, all posted Nov 20.
why_icp: A seed team hiring its first GTM people in two states at once, which means a second state payroll setup right away.
first_line: Saw the 7 roles you posted on Nov 20, including a founding AE in New York.

signal: 18-person company raised a $45M Series A led by Sequoia. 9 open roles on its board.
why_icp: About to grow fast from a small base. Payroll and benefits that keep up as a small team doubles is the core Warp story.
first_line: Congrats on the Series A. Going from 18 people with 9 open roles is a big jump.

signal: New York-based. Raised a $60M Series B at a $1B valuation, $91M total.
why_icp: NYC startup scaling after a big round, the same profile as Warp customers. Worth checking what they run payroll on today.
first_line: Congrats on the Series B. Fellow New York startup here.

signal: Raised a $100M Series A after a customer deal worth $100M in ARR. 7 open roles in San Francisco.
why_icp: Big raise, small team, hiring now. Good fit for an HR, payroll, and IT setup that does not need an ops hire to run it.
first_line: Congrats on the $100M Series A. Saw 7 roles open in SF.

signal: Raised $26M. Over 50 staff across San Francisco, Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, and hiring for go-to-market.
why_icp: U.S. office plus a team abroad. Warp pays international workers in the same system as U.S. payroll.
first_line: Congrats on the $26M. Saw you are building out GTM in San Francisco.

signal: Raised $6.2M led by Chicago Ventures for voice ID tech.
why_icp: Very early team that will make its first payroll and benefits choice soon. Lower score since there is no hiring signal yet.
